components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single high-contrast action on a screen (Send, Save).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; background: #f5f5f5; color: #0a0a0a; font: 500 14px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #ffffff; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #737373; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: default; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supporting actions: New chat, Store key, artifact openers.

components.description: Single-line fields in the connection settings dialog.

narrative.overview: The interface is a sealed room the user controls. Nothing glows for attention, nothing announces itself. Surfaces are quiet and near-black; a single hairline border is the only separation between one region and the next. The mood is calm custody rather than productivity theater. The system is deliberately monochrome: color is a signal, not decoration — blue means an outbound link, red means destruction, green means a stored secret. Restraint is the identity.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black tonal ladder, no shadows, hairline borders only.
One accent color (blue) reserved for outbound links.
Sentence-light labels, uppercase only for status micro-labels.
Flat at rest and flat on interaction; state is shown by tone, not lift or glow.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Color appears only to carry meaning — a link, a destruction, a stored secret. If a color would merely make something prettier, it is not used.

rules.name: The No-Accent-For-Emphasis Rule
rules.body: Never tint a button, a selected row, or a heading with the accent. Selection is shown with neutral-800; the accent is for links alone.

rules.name: The System-Font Rule
rules.body: No webfont is loaded, ever. Type must be identical offline and must not add a network request.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow outside the dialog's least-necessary case. If a region needs to separate, step the tone or add a border.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Depth is conveyed entirely by the neutral ladder and 1px borders. A raised region is a lighter fill, never a floating card.

dos: Do separate regions with a 1px Vault Line border or a step on the neutral ladder — never a shadow.
Do reserve text-primary buttons for the single most important action on a screen.
Do keep the reading column to a 768px measure.
Do show keyboard focus with a visible 2px ring on every interactive element.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent hue or tint a selection with blue.
Don't add hover transforms, lifts, or glows; hover is a tone step only.
Don't load a webfont — the system stack is the identity.
Don't use color as the only cue for state.
